newsitem.title: GERMANY: German labour mkt development uneven - Labour Office.
newsitem.headline: German labour mkt development uneven - Labour Office.

text.p: The head of the German Labour Office Bernhard Jagoda said on Wednesday that developments on the jobs market were uneven in west and east Germany.

"In the jobs market growth is divergent," he said in the text of a speech to be delivered at a news conference. "There is an increasing discrepency between west and east German states. While the jobs market is slowly stabilising in the west, in the east the tendency is still downward."
German unemployment rose to a seasonally adjusted 4.396 million in July.

In western Germany, the number of people out of work on a seasonally adjusted basis fell to 3.029 million in July. East German unemployment increased, with the total number of jobless rising to 1.367 million from 1.340 million.
